title: Television with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- antennae -->
  <line x1='50' y1='22' x2='32' y2='6' stroke='#FFD166' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='50' y1='22' x2='68' y2='6' stroke='#FFD166' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='32' cy='6' r='4' fill='#FF6B9D'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='6' r='4' fill='#FF6B9D'/>
  <!-- TV body -->
  <rect x='10' y='20' width='80' height='62' rx='10' ry='10' fill='#4A90D9'/>
  <!-- body highlight -->
  <rect x='10' y='20' width='80' height='62' rx='10' ry='10' fill='none' stroke='#7FB8F0' stroke-width='3'/>
  <!-- screen -->
  <rect x='18' y='28' width='64' height='42' rx='6' ry='6' fill='#1B2A4A'/>
  <!-- screen glow -->
  <rect x='18' y='28' width='64' height='42' rx='6' ry='6' fill='none' stroke='#3DD6C4' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- face on screen -->
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='36' cy='44' r='6' fill='#3DD6C4'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='44' r='6' fill='#3DD6C4'/>
  <!-- eye highlights -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='42' r='2' fill='#E8FFFB'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='42' r='2' fill='#E8FFFB'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M34 56 Q50 70 66 56' fill='none' stroke='#3DD6C4' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='28' cy='52' r='4' fill='#FF6B9D' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='52' r='4' fill='#FF6B9D' opacity='0.8'/>
  <!-- stand -->
  <rect x='40' y='82' width='20' height='6' rx='2' fill='#3570B0'/>
  <rect x='30' y='88' width='40' height='6' rx='3' fill='#4A90D9'/>
  <!-- stand highlight -->
  <rect x='30' y='88' width='40' height='6' rx='3' fill='none' stroke='#7FB8F0' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- knobs -->
  <circle cx='84' cy='36' r='3' fill='#FFD166'/>
  <circle cx='84' cy='46' r='3' fill='#FF6B9D'/>
  <!-- little feet -->
  <circle cx='22' cy='94' r='4' fill='#FFD166'/>
  <circle cx='78' cy='94' r='4' fill='#FFD166'/>
</svg>
